presets.name: Jezero Crater — Perseverance
presets.scenario: Candidate EVA demo from a hypothetical habitat represented by the historical Mars 2020 landing site toward western delta/lake sediments and the separate Seitah olivine-rich igneous cumulate crater-floor unit (Liu et al., 2022; https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abo2756). Scenario not yet confirmed by the team.
presets.eva_radius_note: The 10 km radial EVA cutoff is a demo assumption, not a NASA requirement or a validated walking/return range.

presets.name: Gale Crater, Mount Sharp — Curiosity
presets.scenario: Candidate EVA demo from a hypothetical habitat represented by historical Bradbury Landing toward the lower slopes of Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons) along the Curiosity traverse corridor. Scenario not yet confirmed by the team.
presets.eva_radius_note: The 10 km radial EVA cutoff is a demo assumption, not a NASA requirement or a validated walking/return range.
